updates.coverageDescription: Rent increases prohibited for RSO units (buildings first built on or before October 1, 1978)
updates.coverageQuote: Effective March 30, 2020, through January 31, 2024, rent increases are prohibited for rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).

updates.coverageDescription: 3% annual rent increase limit applies to RSO units (buildings with certificate of occupancy on or before October 1, 1978)
updates.coverageQuote: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage...Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.

updates.coverageDescription: Non-payment of rent eviction restrictions apply to all RSO and JCO rental units
updates.coverageQuote: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR).

updates.coverageDescription: Right to Counsel notice requirement applies to all RSO and JCO properties
updates.coverageQuote: Beginning August 20, 2025, landlords must post a Notice of Right to Counsel in a conspicuous common area of the residential building where the tenant resides.

updates.coverageDescription: Reduced relocation assistance for 'Mom and Pop' properties (4 or fewer units, natural person owner) for owner/family occupancy evictions
updates.coverageQuote: Landlords of 'Mom and Pop' properties (4 or fewer rental units, natural person owner with no more than 4 units total and one single-family home on separate lot in LA) may pay reduced relocation assistance

updates.coverageDescription: Single-family dwelling relocation assistance (one month's rent) applies to JCO properties owned by natural persons who own no more than 4 dwelling units and one single-family home on separate lot
updates.coverageQuote: When the residential real property is a single-family dwelling subject to the JCO and the owner is a natural person...who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot
